purpose: Admit one source-native Pacific tropical-cyclone structural exposure window after temporal-ontology repair, while preserving an unresolved official-source definition conflict for the North Indian Ocean rather than forcing a canonical phase boundary.

source_plan.institution: Fiji Meteorological and Hydrological Services / RSMC Nadi Tropical Cyclone Centre
source_plan.jurisdiction: South-West Pacific / RSMC Nadi area of responsibility
source_plan.endpoint_role: South-West Pacific tropical cyclone standing season definition and annual outlook reference
source_plan.information_supplied: Official RSMC Nadi statement that the regional tropical cyclone season is between November and April, with explicit warning that out-of-season cyclones can occur.
source_plan.future_schedule_horizon: standing recurring November-April structural season definition; current 2026-27 seasonal outlook not located as of 2026-09-04
source_plan.typical_advance_notice: standing recurring definition; annual activity outlook is a separate publication
source_plan.recommended_verification_cadence: manual pre-season recheck; recheck when the 2026-27 seasonal outlook is published
source_plan.licence_constraints: Fiji Meteorological Services website footer states All Rights Reserved; this record uses only curated factual metadata and does not infer broader reuse rights.
source_plan.rights_summary: Official factual season definition is suitable for manual authoritative reference; the site does not supply a production automation licence in the reviewed surface.
source_plan.automation_summary: No production polling. Reverify manually unless Fiji Met provides an authorised/licensed machine route or permission.
known_limitations: The standing season is an exposure window, not a forecast that any cyclone will occur.
No 2026-27 annual seasonal outlook was located in the official current search surface as of 2026-09-04; no activity-count forecast is imported into this occurrence.
source_plan.notes: Operational governance classification for WORLD SIGNALS; not a legal opinion.

series.series_identity_rule: One annual structural exposure-window occurrence for the RSMC Nadi area of responsibility, keyed by the season year pair rather than by any forecast cyclone count.

deferred_candidates.institution: India Meteorological Department / RSMC New Delhi
deferred_candidates.jurisdiction: North Indian Ocean / WMO-ESCAP Panel region
deferred_candidates.reason: Competent official RSMC/IMD surfaces disagree on the first storm/cyclone-season phase boundary. Canonical population is deferred rather than choosing a preferred definition.

assertions.assertion: two cyclone seasons: April-June and October-December

assertions.source_role: WMO/ESCAP Tropical Cyclone Operational Plan hosted by RSMC New Delhi

deferred_candidates.resolution_required: Identify a current competent operational definition that explicitly resolves April-May versus April-June, or preserve a less precise representation if the institution itself does not define one unique boundary.
